evidence_found: Authentication logs showed repeated failures and unfamiliar IP
lesson_learned: Verify authentication history and source IP before taking action

investigation_summary: Login occurred from a previously unseen location
evidence_found: New IP and location change detected
lesson_learned: Confirm whether location change is legitimate

evidence_found: Multiple failed login events from same source
lesson_learned: Correlate failed attempts with successful login events

investigation_summary: User authenticated from unfamiliar source IP
evidence_found: IP reputation and authentication logs reviewed
lesson_learned: Check IP reputation and previous login history

investigation_summary: Suspicious process activity detected on endpoint
evidence_found: Process activity and endpoint security logs
Sender, attachment and URL evidence collected
Cloud audit logs showed unexpected access
lesson_learned: Review cloud audit logs and permission changes

Repeated login failures but no successful login
evidence_found: Authentication logs showed failed attempts only
lesson_learned: Repeated failures alone should be evaluated with supporting evidence
